when you do your first few low altitiude jumps, you exit the plane, the jumpmaster has your pilot chute (which pulls your main chute out,) you let go, and you're under canopy within 5 secs. then you fly to the airport, with the help of a radio on your collar. when you get to AFF. it's 10k ft, freefall for about a minute, then fly for another minute to land. there's NOTHING that compares to AFF. So a tandem jump will give you AFF, but no control. you're just a passenger on a tandem jump, but solo, it's all you.
